<includeonly><div style="display: flex; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; margin: 0.5em auto; border-left-width: 10px; gap: 10px; {{{style|}}}" class="mbox well quote-{{#switch:{{{border|}}}
| default    = primary
| primary    = primary
| success    = success
| info       = info
| warning    = warning
| danger     = danger
| #default   = primary}}">
<div style="display: flex;">{{#if:{{{image|}}}
| {{{image}}}
| {{#switch:{{{type|}}}
| delete     =<i class="fa fa-times" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| content    =<i class="fa fa-exclamation-triangle" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| style      =<i class="fa fa-css3" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| move       =<i class="fa fa-share" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| protected  =<i class="fa fa-lock" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| help       =<i class="fa fa-hand-paper-o" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| expand     =<i class="fa fa-expand" style="font-size:20px;"></i>
| #default   =<i class="fa fa-pencil" style="font-size:20px;"></i>}}}}</div>
<div style="flex-grow: 1; font-size: 14px; {{{text-style|}}}">{{{text|}}}</div>
</div></includeonly><noinclude>[[Category:huiji template]]{{优质模板|功能}}{{documentation}}
<templatedata>
{
	"description": "本模板用来生成各种页面顶部通知",
	"params": {
		"style": {},
		"border": {
			"description": "可选值：default、primary、success、info、warning、danger",
			"example": "primary",
			"type": "string"
		},
		"image": {
			"description": "图片，若存在则取代图标",
			"example": "[[file:中国.png|80px|link=]]"
		},
		"type": {
			"description": "图标类型，可选值：delete、content、style、move、protected、help、expand"
		},
		"text-style": {
			"description": "显示的文本的样式",
			"type": "string"
		},
		"text": {
			"description": "显示的文本",
			"type": "string"
		}
	}
}
</templatedata>
</noinclude>
